description: Crack a virtual whip on screen to tell your AI to hurry up.

command.crackNow.title: Crack Now (test)
command.choosePreset.title: Choose a Style (leather, neon, fire...)

section.anchorEffect: Virtual Whip: Anchor Point and Effect
virtualWhip.autoStart.description: Show the whip automatically when VS Code starts.
virtualWhip.showOnlyWhenFocused.descript: Only show the whip while the VS Code window has the focus. When disabled, the whip stays visible on top of other applications.
virtualWhip.sensitivity.description: Minimum speed of the sharp gesture (pixels/ms) needed to trigger a crack. Higher = less sensitive. On a very wide screen, raise it if the whip cracks too easily.
virtualWhip.cooldownMs.description: Minimum delay between two cracks, in milliseconds.
virtualWhip.maxLength.description: Maximum length of the whip, in pixels. The tip follows the cursor but can never get farther from the anchor point than this distance.
virtualWhip.anchorPosition.description: Screen corner where the base of the whip is anchored. The anchor point can also be dragged with the mouse (hold the left button on it); choosing a corner here cancels that move.
virtualWhip.messages.description: Messages sent at random to the AI when the whip cracks. **User settings only**: a project folder cannot change them (these texts are typed into your terminal).
virtualWhip.target.description: Where the whip's messages are sent. The focus is never changed.
virtualWhip.target.auto: Claude Code terminal if one is detected, otherwise Copilot chat.
virtualWhip.target.claude: Claude Code terminal only (the active terminal if none is detected).
virtualWhip.target.copilot: Copilot chat only (it must have been clicked at least once in the window).
virtualWhip.interruptBeforeSend.descript: Interrupt the model's ongoing work before sending the message, instead of queuing it until the end of the turn. Claude Code terminal: the Escape key is sent before the message. Copilot: "stop and send".
virtualWhip.interruptDelayMs.description: Delay (ms) between the interruption and sending the message to the Claude Code terminal.
virtualWhip.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning level applied to the model when the whip cracks. **Claude Code terminal only**: sends `/effort <level>` once per terminal. ⚠️ Claude Code saves this level as the model's default (even after the session); `/effort auto` in Claude Code restores it. Not applied to Copilot chat (no public API).
virtualWhip.appearance.preset.descriptio: Built-in style for the whip, the anchor point and the effect. **Appearance settings below that you change take precedence over the style**; the ones you have not touched follow the style. Command: *Virtual Whip: Choose a Style*.
virtualWhip.appearance.preset.neon: Neon: cyan to magenta stroke with a bright glow.
virtualWhip.appearance.preset.fire: Fire: dark red to yellow, warm glow.
virtualWhip.appearance.preset.ice: Ice: glacier blue to white, cold glow.
virtualWhip.appearance.preset.gold: Gold: burnished gold to pale yellow, soft glow.
patternErrorMessage.color: Hexadecimal color expected, for example #785032 or #a53.
virtualWhip.whip.colorBase.description: Color of the base of the rope (#RGB or #RRGGBB). The color gradually shifts to the tip color.
virtualWhip.whip.colorTip.description: Color of the tip of the rope (#RGB or #RRGGBB).
virtualWhip.whip.opacity.description: Opacity of the rope and of the effect, from 0.1 (very transparent) to 1 (opaque).
virtualWhip.whip.thickness.description: Thickness of the rope at the base, in pixels.
virtualWhip.whip.tipThickness.descriptio: Thickness of the rope at the tip, in pixels.
virtualWhip.whip.glow.description: Intensity of the glow around the rope, from 0 (none) to 1.
virtualWhip.whip.gravity.description: Weight of the rope: 0 = it floats, 0.35 = normal, 1.5 = very heavy.
virtualWhip.whip.damping.description: Inertia of the rope: the closer the value is to 1, the longer it keeps swinging after a movement (0.9 = it settles right away).
virtualWhip.anchor.color.description: Color of the anchor point (the circle you can grab with the mouse).
virtualWhip.anchor.size.description: Radius of the anchor point, in pixels.
virtualWhip.effect.enabled.description: Show the flash (shock wave and rays) at the tip of the whip when it cracks.
virtualWhip.effect.size.description: Size of the flash, as a multiple of the normal size.
virtualWhip.effect.durationMs.descriptio: Duration of the flash, in milliseconds.
virtualWhip.effect.rays.description: Number of rays around the shock wave (0 = wave only).
virtualWhip.audioFilePath.description: Absolute path of a crack sound file (`.wav` or `.mp3`). **Empty = built-in sound.** `${workspaceFolder}` is accepted.
virtualWhip.sound.volume.description: Volume of the crack, from 0 (muted) to 100.
